content:
Looking at things like https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/pull/15141, I get the impression that Lean / Lake is planning to officially support some kind of caching mechanism in an upcoming release, but from outside it's hard to tell what the actual roadmap is.
Our project (FormalizedFormalLogic/Foundation) takes a lot of amount of time to build, and I'm planning to set up a pipeline that uses an LLM to automate dependency updates to some extent, but rebuilding Foundation from scratch every time is too impractical, so I'd like to introduce caching. That said, if Lake's cache mechanism is going to change substantially or gain new capabilities going forward, I'd like to design around that direction. What do you think?

FYI: @Mac Malone @Sebastian Ullrich

Translated by Claude

lean4#15141 などを見るに，Lean（Lake）では次回以降のリリースでofficialに何らかのキャッシュ機能がサポートされる予定があるような気がするのですが，外部からはどういう予定になっているかわかりません．我々のプロジェクト (FormalizedFormalLogic/Foundation) はそれなりにビルドすると時間がかかるものです．例えば私はこの依存関係の更新をある程度LLMで自動化するパイプラインを組もうと思っているが，Foundationを毎回ビルドするのは非現実的すぎるのでキャッシュを行いたい．ただ今後のlakeないしreservoirのcache機構が大幅に変わる・追加されるなら，それに追従して設計したい．どうだろうか．

The new lake cache mechanism works quite well. You have to set up your own storage: I've found Cloudflare works well and is cheap.

I don't have documentation to point you at, but if you ask your AI to look at kim-em/hex-dev or TauCetiProject/TauCeti it is pretty easy to work out how to use it.
ps: re "Translated by Claude", I think the zulip AI policy asks that you use pre-LLM technology to do language translation.

Kim Morrison said:

ps: re "Translated by Claude", I think the zulip AI policy asks that you use pre-LLM technology to do language translation.

I don't think such a tool is readily available, as Google Translate is an LLM. What would you recommend using instead?
For now I'm considering to put the cache on Cloudflare R2, but is Lean (FLO?) actually planning to provide an official cache storage via Reservoir or else? From outside, that's curious about for me.

Snir Broshi said:

What would you recommend using instead?

I would recommend telling people that this policy needs a carveout for translation use. :-)

SnO2WMaN said:

For now I'm considering to put the cache on Cloudflare R2, but is Lean (FLO?) actually planning to provide an official cache storage via Reservoir or else? From outside, that's curious about for me.

I may not have up-to-date information here, but I think the plan is that everyone is responsible for their own cache endpoints.
